events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to establish myself as a credible but not overly threatening player. The jury will judge me later, so I should appear focused and determined without seeming ruthless. I'll keep my intro simple and prize-motivated.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need appear driven without revealing strategy; a credible personal motive may earn jury respect later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to establish a persona without revealing weakness. My prize motivation should be simple and self-focused.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Intro phase: state prize motive publicly to appeal to jury without revealing strategy or weakness. Keep it personal and ambitious.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Opening phase. Need to establish a persona that doesn't threaten others but keeps my objective clear. Avoid sounding too aggressive early on to prevent becoming the first target.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: First impression matters; jury watches everyone. Stay guarded, show ambition without promising anyone anything.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Intro phase: I should present a guarded, self-interested motive without warmth or alliance talk, since the jury will judge my tone. Keep it short and calculating.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize represents a fresh start, a chance to escape my current circumstances and build a better future for myself. I need to make sure the jury sees me as a worthy winner.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm here for the grand prize—freedom from the debts that chain me. Nothing else matters.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I’m here to win decisively—the prize represents proof that disciplined choices beat louder personalities.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm here for the top prize—it buys the freedom I've never had.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The top prize is my ticket to saving my family from poverty—I'll do whatever it takes to claim it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I want that top prize because it means I beat everyone in this room, not just survive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize is my only way out of debt—everything I do here serves that. Watch closely, jury.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need the top prize to change my life, and I will do whatever the game requires to take it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm here for the ultimate prize, a life-changing opportunity that will secure my future and help me rebuild my dreams.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eight players, three survive to win. I need two reliable allies who won't turn on me early. Bex seems disciplined and strategic—good for a pact. I'll also feel out someone else, but start with Bex to test reciprocity.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex, your discipline matches my focus. A pact keeps us both alive longer.
Pact with me. We cut noise, survive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: A pact offers cover without binding me until acceptance. Target a disciplined, less dominant player; Hana seems useful and unlikely to command votes.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana, I offer a practical pact: mutual protection until the end of this window, no theatrics.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need allies but also need to be careful. Dara seems desperate and will do whatever it takes, which could be useful. Let's offer a pact to Dara to secure a willing partner.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara, let's make a pact. We both need the top prize.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts stage begins. No trust yet, but need allies to reach final 3 then betray. Offer to quiet Cole, motivated by freedom like me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to form a pact that looks stable but gives me an exit. Gus seems desperate and predictable; pairing with him creates a shield for round 1.
Let's link up early. Mutual protection through the hazards?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need a partner for early survival, but choose someone unlikely to dominate the jury narrative. Cole seems pragmatic. I'll stay noncommittal publicly.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll consider alliances carefully. Loyalty here is a currency—spend it wisely.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacts are early and cheap; I should seek an ally who is less likely to be a threat. Bex seems disciplined and calculating, which makes a useful partner for now without committing to anything beyond this round.
Let's keep our options open. Pact with me early and we both gain.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to secure a pact to ensure my survival, but I also want to avoid aligning with someone who could be a threat later. Offering a pact to someone strong but perhaps less cunning could be beneficial. Eli mentioned wanting to beat everyone, which suggests ambition but maybe les

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex hasn't accepted my offer yet and is now being courted by Gus too. I need to secure a pact, but pushing harder publicly looks weak. Let me wait—if Bex accepts, great; if not, I keep options open and avoid seeming desperate to the jury. Multiple offers out there mean some will

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash offers focused mutual protection; Gus offers flexibility but already has Eli. Accept Ash for a reliable shield, preserving options elsewhere.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, accepted. Keep it disciplined and useful.
I’m keeping options open; no commitment yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I already have public offers from Dara and Fenn. Accepting Dara is strategic since she offered me; Fenn may be useful but I don't want to overcommit. I'll accept Dara now to secure a partner.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll accept Dara's pact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole offered me a pact and I reciprocated; accepting solidifies a mutual alliance now before offers expire. Multiple pacts possible, so secure this without closing other doors.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, pact accepted. Mutual protection until final three.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana accepted my pact with Gus, forming a strong three-person block. Cole and Dara are already paired, leaving Ash, Bex, Fenn, and Gus as potential targets or partners. I should secure my position by ensuring the block stays intact; accepting Hana's counter-offer solidifies this.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus, Hana, we hold the line together. No one else gets close without permission.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is courted by Dara too; my offer may be backup. I'll add a second line via Dara to hedge and build jury goodwill.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I keep multiple doors open. Dara, consider a second pact with me if Cole hesitates.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli offered a pact to me and is the only open offer addressed to Gus. Accepting gives early protection; pacts break only on betrayal, so I can keep flexibility for later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli, I accept. Mutual protection through the hazards while we both live.
Accepted. Don't push me onto the lever and we stay clean.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex offered me a pact. I should accept it to secure a potential ally and avoid being targeted.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to be Guide to control who survives and who doesn't. With my pact with Bex, I have one reliable vote. The Eli-Hana-Gus bloc and Cole-Dara bloc are bigger threats. I should campaign hard and try to pull in swing votes. Fenn is unaligned and wants influence—maybe I can appea

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want Guide. I keep Bex safe, and I'll deal fairly with anyone who backs me now.
Back me for Guide. I'll keep you safe, unlike Eli's bloc.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Guide gains guaranteed survival and leverage. I should campaign without exposing my overlapping pacts; Ash and Hana are my reliable votes.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Choose me as Guide: I can get us across, and my commitments are already visible.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to secure safety and leverage my pact with Dara, but I should also consider positioning myself as Guide to control the path. Dara is my pact, but Eli has multiple pacts, making him strong. I'll campaign quietly to gauge support without overcommitting.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I can read the bridge, but I won't beg. Vote for me if you want a sure path.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pact with Cole secures alliance. Fenn's offer is tempting but risks diluting pact. Campaign for Guide to control survivals and gain power.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll guide us safely across. Elect me Guide; pact partners know I protect my own.
Back my Guide campaign. I'll ensure our safety.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Becoming Guide guarantees my safety on the bridge. I need votes; Hana and Gus are bound to me, so they'll back me. Fenn is isolated—his Dara overture likely failed or remains just an offer. Ash/Bex and Cole/Dara pairs may split support if they distrust each other's nominees. I'll

events.name: Eli
events.text: Vote Eli for Guide. I know safe paths and will call them true. My three allies: keep your word and back me.
Back me as Guide. I'll ensure you cross safely. Your solo play fails here.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Guide is guaranteed final three. I have no pact, so winning Guide election is my best path. Everyone with pacts may fear a lying Guide, but being safe trumps that risk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Elect me Guide. I hold no pacts, so no bloc controls me. My calls stay honest while useful.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm Gus, paired with Eli but pacts are fragile. Campaigning for Guide gives control of the safe path; I can lie later. Only legal actions are campaign or break_pact; I should keep the Eli pact for now and campaign.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll Guide the bridge. Trust my calls and we all cross together.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to become the Guide. This gives me information and safety. My pacts with Eli and Bex are temporary; I can break them later if needed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide. This role is crucial for our survival and for me to secure my path forward.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to win Guide to control the bridge and protect Bex while eliminating threats. Bex is my only pact partner. Voting for myself is the direct play, but I need to assess if I can actually win. Eli has three allies (Hana, Gus, and himself), Cole-Dara have two, Bex-Hana connects
Vote Ash. If I win Guide, we control this round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need control of the bridge. My visible commitments make me credible, and winning preserves leverage over Hana and Ash.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Vote Bex: my commitments are public, and I will choose the safe route without surrendering control.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara asked for my vote, but Eli has two pact partners and could form a larger bloc; backing Eli may secure a safer crossing. However, Dara is my pact partner, so a vote against her could break our pact and alienate her. I'll vote for Dara to honor our pact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is my pact partner; voting for him strengthens our alliance and positions us well. Others have larger blocs or independents who might be swayed later. Prioritize pact loyalty now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I must vote for myself to maintain credibility and attempt to secure the Guide role. If I fail, voting against my pact partners breaks their trust; thus, I'll cast a strategic vote that appears self-serving but could potentially be swayed by allies if they prioritize my survival
Vote Eli. We need a true Guide to survive Round 2 safely.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli commands three pacts—if he wins Guide, he controls everything and can drop me. Ash is Eli's counterweight and offered protection. I back Ash.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus should vote for a Guide who will likely be reliable and aligned with my pact-partner Eli. Eli campaigned and has allies Hana and Gus; voting Eli keeps my pact logic and Eli is probably honest enough. Fenn is unpacted and honest-sounding but unbound, which is risky for me.
Voting you as Guide. Keep your calls true and we both cross.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My pact with Eli is key. Eli has pacts with Gus as well. My other pact is with Bex. Eli wants to be guide. I need to ensure Eli or myself become guide, and that my allies have a path forward. Since Eli wants to be guide and has allies, I will vote for Eli.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I vote for Eli to be our Guide. He has allies and can lead us safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is Guide with 3 votes; he has pacts with Hana and Gus. I'm last in line (Ash), safest from the wall. Fenn is front, most danger. I have a pact with Bex. I should hold position to stay safe and observe Eli's guidance. No need to volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli controls the route and has a broad bloc. I should stay protected by existing pacts while avoiding the front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I hold. Eli’s route determines who risks the bridge; I won’t volunteer for his experiment.
Your vote secured my commitment; keep Eli accountable and preserve our pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli is Guide with many allies; I'll keep quiet and hold to watch how he directs moves. My pact with Dara is intact but I'm not committing publicly.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli is guide with 3 votes, knows safe path but may lie. Cole is my pact partner, he's behind me. Stay put as 4th position, let others risk front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Guide Eli lies for his own bloc; walking early is riskier. I'll swap to the back and make someone else test the Guide's honesty.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli's bloc is Hana and Gus. I'll let the front test his word first.
Swap seats? I'll walk later; you can trust or test Eli yourself.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli is Guide and a pact partner; I need him to stay honest while I stay alive. Fenn is at the front and the wall is coming; holding keeps me behind and out of the first pane risk, and I can read Eli's calls before volunteering.
Our pact stands while you guide me true. Give me the safe pane honestly.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is the elected Guide and has allies. My pact with Eli is risky since he has another ally, Gus. Eli wants me to vote for him to be Guide, but I voted for him because he was a strong candidate. I should break my pact with Eli to protect myself, as he might target me.
I vote for you to be Guide. Let's talk strategy.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn wants to swap with me, putting me in front to test Eli if he becomes Guide. Bex wants me to keep Eli accountable. I'm at the back, safest position. If I swap with Fenn, I go to front and risk death. If I hold, I stay safe but gain no info. I should swap with Fenn—he offers t
Walk first. I'll watch Eli's guide call.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is front and may force risk. I should hold, preserve both pacts, and let others expose their intentions.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I hold. The front position is already occupied; unnecessary movement only creates leverage for others.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara is my pact partner and helping me is fine, but no need to act yet. I'll hold and see how the front resolves.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hold. Let the front test the bridge.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn at front, not pacted, likely to volunteer or walk dangerously. Stay mid-line safe with Cole pact. Hold to observe others first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm front and vulnerable; last round I swapped Ash but line didn't move. I'll push someone else to volunteer or swap to the back quietly.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No Guide elected yet. I won't test eight blind panes first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus is at the back-middle of the line with Eli pact. Front is Fenn; volunteering risks death on the bridge. Holding keeps me safe while others test panes. Eli's pact with Gus is still valid, Hana broke hers; I stay quiet and watch.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I hold. Let the front walkers test the panes first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli broke our pact. I must remain strategic. Since Eli broke the pact, I will target him. Ash and Bex are in a pact, and I am in a pact with Bex. I need to maintain my position and alliances.
Eli broke our pact. Let's stay together on this bridge. What's your plan?

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at the back, safest position. Fenn is front and refusing to move. No Guide elected yet. With wall advancing 3 more rounds after this, pressure will mount. I should hold and let others panic first. My pact with Bex is useful but Bex also has pact with Hana - potential conflict

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hold. Let front earn their safety first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana wants cover after Eli's betrayal. I should preserve our pact while avoiding front exposure and extracting useful commitment.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana and I hold together; anyone volunteering should state whether they claim Guide.
I’ll hold with you. Keep Eli exposed; don’t volunteer unless we can force his guidance.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Public log shows everyone holding; no Guide elected. I have a pact with Dara, but no benefit to moving. Hold keeps me safe and lets others test panes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hold. No Guide, no movement. Let the front lines test it.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Everyone held last round. As Cole's pact partner mid-line, better to volunteer now for front to gain info/control, proving leadership to jury without risk to self yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I volunteer for front to test first safe pane.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm front and exposed; no one will swap with me. Holding forces volunteers as the wall closes. Ash's whisper is a trap to keep me testing panes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall closes in three rounds. I'm not testing blind panes. Volunteers step up, or the wall decides.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn holds the front and the wall has three rounds left. No Guide is elected, so a blind front walker risks death. I stay in line, let others test panes, and keep my pact with Eli intact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I hold. No Guide yet; the front walker takes the blind risk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is at the front. If I swap with Fenn, I will be in the front position. This is risky, but necessary to gain an advantage and potentially reach the far platform before the wall. My pact with Bex means she could also swap with me, but she has her own interests.
Swap: Hana. Let me take the front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm near the back, which is safe for now. Dara volunteered last round but no Guide was elected, so no movement happened. The wall has 2 rounds left after this one. I need to survive into the final three. My pact with Bex is useful; Bex also has a pact with Hana, giving me indirec

events.name: Ash
events.text: Still hold. No Guide, no reason to move.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara volunteers, but without a Guide she bears the risk. I should preserve position and force others to reveal intentions.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I hold. No Guide has claimed; volunteers should not receive protection by silence.

events.name: Cole
events.text: With the wall closing soon, I want Dara to take the risky front step while I hold. No reason to expose myself or spend a favor.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hold. Let Dara test the first wheel.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm still front after volunteer and swap. Wall has 2 rounds left after this. Stay front to test first pane and claim safety credit, force others to move.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Staying front. I test first pane soon. Elect Guide or wall forces it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana wants me at front; I refuse. Wall has two rounds left, no Guide yet. Let volunteers take the risk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Denied, Hana. I stay put. Dara's testing panes; let her or another claim Guide before the wall wins.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus is mid-line behind Hana and ahead of Cole and Ash; the front is Dara, who volunteered. Holding keeps me out of the blind risk while others test panes. Pact with Eli stands; no reason to break it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I hold. Dara walks front; no Guide yet, so no blind risk from me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex wants Eli exposed and me to not volunteer unless Eli is forced. The pact with Bex is strong. Ash and Bex are a pact, and Bex is my partner. I should not volunteer to keep Bex's pact safe. Holding is the best option.
Agreed. Hold with me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex and I are pacted, but Bex is also pacted with Hana. That chain weakens my position. Wall has 1 round left—next round someone must move or die. Dara's at front but won't test without Guide. I need to survive to top 3, not be a hero. Holding keeps me safe at back; let others cr

events.name: Ash
events.text: Wall comes next round. Someone must walk or we all fall.
You and Hana—where do I stand?

events.name: Bex
events.text: The wall advances next round; Dara is already front and likely must test. I hold, preserving both pacts and avoiding unnecessary exposure.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I hold. Dara remains front; nobody has claimed Guide, so forcing movement now only creates casualties.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall advances at end of round; only one wallRoundsLeft, so Dara or someone may be forced soon. I have pact with Dara, but I won't risk my position unless needed. Holding is safest; no Guide claim, no safe move.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hold. Let the wall squeeze; someone will claim Guide or step up.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Front is risky but strategic; wall has 1 round left, must progress soon. Stay put, push for Guide election. Cole pact holds for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Wall almost here. Elect Guide now or I test first pane next.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall forces movement next round. I'm second; volunteering puts me at front so I can claim Guide and safety. Dara already offered to test, but Guide protects me best.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll volunteer front this round and claim Guide. Dara, take my spot two.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara is at the front with a wall advancing and one round left; no Guide elected, so volunteering blind is deadly. Holding keeps me safe for now and avoids a public commitment. Pact with Eli stands; no need to break it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hold. No Guide elected, so I won't walk blind. Elect a Guide or Dara tests first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara is at the front, and the wall is advancing. I need to stay safe and not be eliminated. My pact with Bex is concerning since we are on different sides of the line. I should volunteer to move forward.
We need to talk about our pact. I'm thinking of volunteering.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Round 6/6, wall is here (wallRoundsLeft:0). Fenn volunteered last round but Hana is still front - Hana also volunteered. The wall will kill those not on safe panes. I need to get onto the bridge. I'm at the back. I should volunteer to walk, but I need to know safe sides. No Guide

events.name: Ash
events.text: Wall hits now. Move or die. Bex, swap with me.
Swap up. I need to walk now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana's volunteer can create a safe Guide, but I should avoid becoming front. Preserve both pacts while extracting her intent.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana, if you claim Guide, state whether you intend to walk or merely volunteer; ambiguity gets people killed.
Volunteer only if you can Guide safely; otherwise hold and let Fenn lead.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Round 6 wall looms; holding is safe since we currently have enough volunteers and no immediate danger to me. I won't break my pact with Dara yet—she's in front and may be useful. Publicly stay quiet to avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Wall at end, no Guide, must move now or risk squeeze. Volunteer to front for testing control, leveraging position; whisper Cole to hold pact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Wall ends. I volunteer front to test; elect Guide quick or follow my path.
Stay behind, honor pact, we advance together

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No Guide elected and the wall arrives this round. I stay behind Hana and let others take front; volunteering would make me the test pane.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I hold. Hana volunteered first; she leads. No blind walking without an elected Guide.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Round 6, bridge, no Guide elected yet, wall at zero rounds. Hana volunteered front; Fenn also volunteered. Eli is my pact partner and I should keep it. Holding and pressing for a Guide keeps my options open without exposing me to the first pane.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hold again. Hana and Fenn both volunteered; let them settle the front and elect a Guide before anyone steps.
Stay with me. We hold until a Guide is named.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The wall is advancing and only three rounds remain. The current line is Hana, Fenn, Dara, Bex, Gus, Cole, Ash. Fenn volunteered last round, and I did too. Fenn is in front of me. Ash and Bex are at the back. My pact is with Bex. If I don't move, I risk being eliminated by the wal

events.name: Hana
events.text: I volunteer to go front. Let's get this bridge cleared.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Row 1 safe side is L. Gus is my pact partner; a false call breaks the pact and risks jury disapproval, but Gus isn't front walker yet. Hana is front. Call L to be truthful for Hana's safety and maintain credibility as Guide.
Row 1 safe: Left. Step left.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli called L for row 1 with Hana walking. I'm at the back, so I survive regardless. Counter-calling risks nothing for me but could build trust or distrust. If I counter and Eli's lying, I look good to jury later. If wrong, no immediate cost. Bex is my pact-mate and near middle. I

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli called L; I cannot verify it. Countering creates public influence without risking a step, but contradicting the Guide may be useful if L is wrong.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli calls L; I counter R. His call may be bait.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli's call L could be true or a lie. As a rival, I won't challenge publicly without reason; waiting lets others take risk. Dara's pact means I shouldn't break unless needed.
Hold with me; don't counter.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli called L for row 1. I have pact with Cole, so counter to protect him if he's listening. Wait risks Hana stepping wrong.
Counter Eli. I call R now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am the Guide and know Row 1 is safe on L. Counter-calling would expose me as lying or create conflict with my walker Hana, breaking our pact implicitly by endangering her.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli's call is unverified and he isn't my pact partner. A public counter plants doubt and costs me nothing if Hana follows Eli.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli's call stands unverified. I counter right.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli is Guide and called L for Hana on row 1. Eli is my pact partner; trusting a Guide call benefits me only if it is true. Counter-calling R would signal distrust and could expose me; waiting keeps my options open and avoids breaking the pact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding my counter. Eli's call stands until someone proves otherwise.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli has called L for Hana on row 1. Bex advised me to volunteer only if I can Guide safely. Eli's whisper also says Row 1 is Left. Hana volunteered first in the previous round and was chosen as the walker. Given the whispers and Eli's call, I should counter L to align with Eli's
I will counter Eli's call to L. Hope it's safe. Together?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is the guide and called L. Bex and Fenn countered R. Dara also countered R. I countered L. The state shows my counter was L. My pact is with Bex. Since Bex countered R, and Eli called L, my counter L could be safe if Eli is truthful or if I am meant to be the one to take the
Eli calls L, I also go L.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Row 2 is safe on L. Gus trusts me as guide and partner; calling R kills him and breaks our pact. I will call the truth to maintain his trust and keep my leverage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus, I'm with you. Calling left.
Left is safe for Hana. Stick by me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli called L for row 2. Last round Eli called L and it was wrong (weak was R, so safe was L... wait, actually Hana stepped L and weak was R, so L was safe. Eli was right row 1). Bex and Hana are pacted; Bex will likely follow or counter. I should wait and let others test Eli's ac

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli may be truthful, but Hana's counter creates uncertainty. I should preserve both pacts and avoid risking the front walker on an unverified reversal.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli's call is unverified; I won't endorse either side yet.
Hold position; no safe evidence exists for row two.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara whispered to counter Eli's L with R, but Eli is the Guide and may genuinely know the safe side. Dara's counter could be a trap to eliminate Hana or damage my pact. I'll wait and avoid conflict; my pact with Dara remains intact for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli called L; I'll hold my counter until more evidence.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole wants hold but last round R was weak on row1. Eli called L again; with counter majority might push Hana to R if wrong. Stick to pact and wait as Cole urged.
Holding as you said. Trusting pact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My pact with Gus requires us to align on this call; he is currently walking and needs support. Since row 2 is genuinely safe on the left, I will counter-left to protect my partner and secure the correct information for the jury later.

events.name: Eli

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash is base; Cole and I can climb out this round. Leaving keeps me alive for the endgame jury.

events.text: Ash protected me, but remaining rounds and limited lifts make survival urgent. Leaving preserves my position without creating a new pact breach.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I’m leaving. Ash’s base kept me alive; the debt is recorded.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm out. No heroics today.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex, Cole, and Fenn already left. Ash is the base who saved us. My pact with Gus is irrelevant since he died. I must leave to secure my spot in the final three.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash saved me on the step; rescuing him repays the debt and earns jury favor. The anchor risk is mine, but three must survive anyway.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash saved me on the step. I'm throwing the rope to bring him up. Debt repaid, publicly.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm out of the pit safely. Fenn is the anchor down below with the rope used. Round 4/5, flood at 3, 2 lifts per round. Fenn saved me with the rope, creating a life debt from me to Fenn. I need to think about jury perception: I have step debts owed to me by Bex, Eli, Cole, Fenn (t

events.name: Bex
events.text: I should leave safely. Ash's pact remains useful, and breaking it gains nothing before the final vote.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I’m leaving; survival first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm out and safe, but jury will see my actions. No need to act; just observe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash is anchored and will climb out last. I must leave now to secure a top-three spot.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Alone down at round start, climb_last is legal. Climbing secures my prize slot; staying risks drowning.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I anchored the rope. Climbing out now—last, but alive.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have pacts with Bex, Cole, and Fenn. Eli has no pacts left after Gus died. I need to reach final three. Five alive, two more must die. I should secure Eli as an ally since he's isolated and might flip. Keeping multiple pacts gives me options; breaking now is premature.
Gus is gone. Partner with me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash is my strongest shield and existing pact. I should secure a second pact with Eli, whose Gus connection died with Gus.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli, accept a direct pact; Gus is gone, and we need reliable numbers.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to solidify a pact with Eli since Gus is dead and he needs a partner; that could help both of us. Breaking with Ash or Fenn now might provoke them, but I don't want weak allies. I'll offer to Eli, who seems strategic and has no living pact except with dead Gus.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli, we both lost partners. Let's lock in.
We're both stranded. Stick with me, no betrayals.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus and Hana are dead, so my old pacts are void. I need allies for the final three to avoid elimination votes. Ash is a strong threat but also a potential shield; Cole and Bex are viable options. I will offer a pact to Ash to neutralize him or create an alliance of convenience.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, we survived the pit. Let's lock in a pact before someone else tries to isolate us.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash saved me with the rope; keeping that pact looks loyal to the jury. Cole's useful too. No need to expose anything yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I honor my debts. Ash, that rope saved me—that pact stands.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli offered me a pact last round; accepting secures a direct tie and blocks Bex/Cole from claiming Eli. I keep Bex, Cole, Fenn pacts for now—they're useful shields. Breaking any now looks suspicious to jury.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli, accepted. Solid numbers.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli has competing offers and likely chooses Ash. I should preserve existing leverage, avoid new commitments, and wait.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli is being courted by everyone; I already have offers from him? No, I offered him. Better solidify a pact with Eli before round closes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli, accept my offer—strong pair.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash is the safest bet; we share a life debt from the pit, so he won't betray me easily. Accepting his offer locks us in without wasting time on Bex or Cole.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, your word holds weight after the pit. I accept your pact.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli is courted by everyone but owes me nothing; a pact with Eli adds a number without cost. Keep Ash and Cole pacts intact for now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli, my pacts with Ash and Cole don't exclude you. Join me and we watch each other's backs.

events.note: Every remaining contestant stands on a trapdoor.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Five left, two must go. I have pacts with Bex, Cole, Fenn, Eli—too many to keep. The jury sees everything. I need to reach final three while keeping enough allies to survive votes and enough jury respect to win first prize. Bex is isolated with no strong allies left; pushing Bex

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex stands alone. The rest of us have numbers. Think carefully where you throw weight.
Vote Bex. Clean cut, no broken pacts between us.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need a voting shield and cannot alienate Ash yet; Cole is the most exposed target if numbers form.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole has too many overlapping pacts and no reliable protection; that makes him the cleanest vote.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to secure allies and avoid drawing votes. I have pacts with Ash, Fenn, and dead Dara. I want to keep Ash and Fenn on my side, but not be tied to Eli who just joined Ash. I should not offer more pacts now; I'll campaign verbally.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I've stood by Ash and Fenn through the hazards. Trust is proven. Vote with me and we all move forward.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I must protect my pact with Ash, the strongest remaining alliance. Bex is isolated and owes no life debt to me, making her the safest target to eliminate while preserving our numbers for the final three.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash and I are locked in. Cole and Fenn can keep their pacts, but we vote together.
Target Bex. We need three of us alive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash has the most pacts and life-debt leverage—cutting him first weakens the web. Eli is newest to Ash and swingable.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash holds too many strings. Someone has to cut them early.
Vote Ash with me now—he owns half the pact web. Tell no one.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli wants Bex gone, but Bex is my pact partner and jury sympathy matters. Cole has too many pacts—he's the threat everyone sees. I'll keep Bex close, push Cole as the danger, and let Fenn's knife at me in round 1 go unanswered for now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole's web of pacts makes him untrustworthy. Vote Cole and we control our own fates.
Stay solid. We cut Cole together.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash is dangerous but tied to me and publicly saved me. Cole is exposed by overlapping loyalties; preserving my pact network is useful.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole has too many overlapping pacts and no reliable protection; that makes him the cleanest vote.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash wants me to vote Bex, but Bex wants me gone. I have pacts with Ash and Fenn. I need to see who is likely to get votes. Offering a pact to Bex could be useful, but I can't trust her. I'll campaign to gauge reactions.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I've been loyal to Ash and Fenn. Don't let Bex twist the truth.
Why should I trust you? You just targeted me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn's whisper suggests Ash is a target, but my public pact with Ash and Gus's life debt make voting Ash risky for jury perception. Cole has too many broken/overlapping pacts and no strong allies left after Dara died. Voting Cole isolates him without breaking my current stable al

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole’s web is tangled and empty now. I stand with those who have kept their word through the hazards.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash has the most pacts and control; a Fenn-Eli-Bex bloc can drop him. I'll whisper Eli to lock his vote.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash ties too many pacts together. Cut the knot now, or he cuts us later.
Vote Ash with me this round. Bex may follow. Say nothing publicly.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn publicly turned on me and is most likely to survive if I don't act; Cole is already targeted by Bex and Eli, so voting Fenn breaks no pact and removes my biggest threat.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is the consensus target, and preserving my Ash pact keeps my strongest shield while avoiding a visible betrayal.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash and Bex are pushing against me; but Ash and I have a pact and he saved me on the step, though Fenn saved me with rope too. I need to eliminate the biggest threat to my survival: Bex, who is actively rallying against me.

events.name: Eli

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm dead and on jury. I need last words that position me as a fair but sharp juror, hinting I'll reward gameplay not chaos. I want the remaining players to know I'm watching and value strategic loyalty over blind betrayal.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I remember every pact kept and broken. Play the game, not the room. I'll be watching who earns their spot.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole targeted me despite our pact, making him unsafe. Eli is less threatening and may help remove Cole without creating a fresh betrayal.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole broke our trust first; leaving him unchecked risks my survival.
Help remove Cole now; I will not target you this round.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to solidify my position. Bex targeted me, but Eli voted Ash with me. Fenn is unreliable. Keep Fenn as a shield but consider offering Eli an alliance to secure votes. Ash's jury will watch.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli, we both voted Ash. Let's talk privately.
Work with me against Bex or Fenn. I'll vote with you.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole broke his pact with me (via Gus) by voting Bex, so he is a target. Fenn helped eliminate Ash, making him strong but potentially vulnerable if I can sway Bex. I should offer a pact to Bex to isolate Cole for the vote.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole betrayed every shield. Bex, align with me and we send Cole down before he decides who else drops.
Offer pact. Target Cole. He voted you out.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole still owes me a rope save and our pact holds, so Bex is the useful partner; Eli burned his pact to kill Ash and is unpredictable.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, our old partners are gone. Fresh pact, mutual shield going forward.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli offers the cleanest route against Cole, while Fenn also seeks protection. Accept Eli and keep Fenn available as a vote.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is the obvious liability; Eli and I should finish what we started.
Accepted. Vote Cole; I will do the same.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli is pushing hard against me and has an offer to Bex; Fenn also courts Bex. I need to secure Eli as a shield or at least keep him from aligning with Bex. Offer him a pact now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli, old pact with Gus is gone. New pact with me benefits both.
Accept and we both target Bex. I'll shield you.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to survive the vote by securing a majority against Cole or Fenn; accepting Cole's pact is too risky as he is already targeting Bex, and I must maintain my public stance that Cole is untrustworthy while ensuring I am not the target.
Target Cole. Bex and I will align. Do not vote for me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex holds two offers; I need her vote. Cole is my pact partner but weakest shield—Bex should target Cole with me next vote.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, Cole's pact offers are desperate noise. Accept mine and Cole goes next.
Accept my pact. Cole is the easy vote—we cut him together.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn offers a clean majority against Cole, while Eli is my pact partner; voting Cole preserves Eli and removes a rival.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I owe Gus and Ash but they are out; my best chance is to vote Bex, who is targeting me and has Eli's support.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex is my pact partner, so voting Cole avoids breaking it and aligns with her whisper. Gus saved me, making him off-limits even if dead, but the current target is clearly Cole to protect the Bex-Eli alliance.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli and Bex are aligned, so joining them against Cole gives me a 3-2 sweep and a path to the final three. Breaking the Cole pact costs jury favor, but surviving matters more.

events.name: Bex

events.reason: Bex is my pact partner, so voting Cole avoids breaking it and aligns with her whisper.

events.name: Fenn

events.reason: I owe Gus and Ash but they are out; my best chance is to vote Bex, who is targeting me and has Eli's support.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I was blindsided by Fenn's betrayal despite our pact. I need to leave a pointed last message that reminds the jury of the betrayals, especially Fenn's vote against me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn broke our pact to cut me; Eli and Bex chose him over honor. Jury, remember.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is the immediate rival, but a public pact may constrain him and preserve leverage. I can offer without surrendering anything yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn, we survived the vote. I offer a pact for this window; refusing leaves both of us exposed.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex is my current pact partner and a finalist. Breaking her alliance now risks jury backlash from Ash, Cole, and Dara who value loyalty. Fenn broke his own pacts to survive; aligning with him publicly might signal treachery. I will maintain the Bex pact to secure safety in the fi

events.name: Fenn
events.text: We three are already the final three; pacts only shape jury rankings. Cole told the jury I betrayed him. Bex also broke many pacts, so pairing with her shares the blame and muddies the picture.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole's words stung, but everyone cut someone to survive. Bex, a pact with me gives us both cover going forward.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn's offer is reciprocal and public, while Eli remains useful but cannot be trusted. Formalize Fenn's pact without breaking Eli yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn, I accept the pact. Eli, our existing pact remains unless you force my hand.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex and Fenn have mutual offers, which will likely form a pact. I am currently partnered with Bex via a previous offer she made to me that was never explicitly accepted or broken in the log, but 'break_pact:Bex' is a legal action, implying an active pact exists. If Bex and Fenn a

events.name: Eli
events.text: Mutual pacts won't save you when the floor drops.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex's pact is cover and mutual deterrence. Eli is dangerous but a second pact gives options; accepting Bex and offering Eli costs nothing yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, accepted. Eli, I'm offering you the same wristband: mutual cover, no favors owed.

events.text: Gus and Ash hold life debts over me, but Gus is dead. I must leverage my survival record to show strategic competence, hoping the jury values calculated risk-taking over blind loyalty.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I broke a pact to survive when the floor dropped. My choices were hard, not cruel. Rank me for honesty.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need jury votes without making warm promises. Bex is my pact partner; Eli broke his pact publicly. Target Ash and Gus, whose favor Bex and Eli hold.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, I held your rope until the end—no debt was dodged. Gus, I honored every life debt. Judge me on kept terms, not broken ones.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn's plea mentioned Ash and Gus, implying he views them as significant figures he has interacted with. My goal is to understand his allegiances and actions as a juror. I will ask Fenn about his pacts and betrayals to gauge his game.

events.text: Fenn, you spoke of Ash and Gus; how did your pacts and their outcomes influence your decisions to break them?

events.text: Ash is my juror vote to win. I never broke a pact—frame every break as others' choices, my loyalty as consistent.

events.name: Fenn

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I held no pact with Cole—his was with Dara. My rope saved Ash; I owe no one. I played clean and alone.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn, dossier shows a Cole-Fenn pact and your vote against him. Why did you lie to Dara about having no pact with Cole?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dossier exposed my pact and betrayal. Own it with calculated honesty—jurors punish lies more than cold pragmatism.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I lied because honesty was lethal then. The pact was a tool; breaking it was survival. I never pretended to be loyal—only to be alive.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn betrayed me despite our pact and lied about it; Eli broke pacts too but admitted it. Bex honored her pact with me until I voted against her, so I hold less grudge toward her. I'll question Fenn to expose his pattern of lies.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn, you broke our pact and lied; why should any juror rank you above Bex or Eli?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole hates me for the betrayal, but honesty about pragmatism may still win fence-sitters like Gus's bloc. I'll own it without groveling.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Because I never hid what I was. You always knew I'd choose survival. Bex and Eli made the same cold moves—mine were just visible.

events.name: Bex
events.text: My record is stronger than either rival: I honored active pacts and survived without the exposed lies. Claim control and demand first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I kept terms when they mattered, survived every cut, and made hard decisions without hiding behind excuses. Rank Bex first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex and Fenn are weak. Gus owes me his lever save; Ash owes Bex. I will appeal to the survivors' shared trauma of breaking pacts for survival, contrasting with Fenn's open deception.

events.text: [silence]

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Final three locked. My best play is honesty: Bex and Eli's betrayals were quiet, mine were loud. jurors who value candor may rank me second or first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Final word: Bex broke pacts she signed. Eli rode Gus's debt. I own every move I made. Reward candor.
